title: 3D GUI Door Models
description: Replaces the model of every door with it's 3D variant.
body:
# About
This resource pack replaces the GUI model of every door with it's 3D variant. The new model shows the upper part of the door. The resource pack affects the door model only when it's displayed in GUI.

# Example
![Model comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LXHbJw10/images/f3c8d7fa0e7168047709a962f8f9e433c46d5d99.png)
